raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivered 333 transactions. Each copy has the same txn_id, amount, and status, but one copy stores txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (1768716039000, which is 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC and matches the ISO copy), and the cast to TIMESTAMP fails on it. The fix is to parse epoch-millis values as UTC, keep one row per txn_id (the earliest-ingested copy), and leave the gold steps unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, COALESCE(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP), make_timestamp(TRY_CAST(t.txn_ts AS BIGINT) * 1000)) AS txn_ts_parsed, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.txn_id ORDER BY t.ingest_ts) AS rn FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED') x WHERE rn = 1;"}}
